newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Buenos Aires area poverty at 26.3 pct - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Buenos Aires area poverty at 26.3 pct - ministry.

text.p: The percentage of Argentines living below the poverty line in the Buenos Aires area fell to 26.3 percent in May from 27.9 percent a year earlier, according to data released by the Economy Ministry Thursday.
In May 1989, the year when the current government came to power, the proportion of people below the poverty line was 25.9 percent. In May 1988 it was 29.8 percent.
Meanwhile, the number of households under the poverty line without any form of income, was at 4.1 percent of all households in May, compared with 5.5 percent in 1996.
In the country as a whole, 18.8 percent of households were under the poverty line in May.

"We have fulfilled virtually every aspect of the economy -- country risk has fallen, industrial production is rising, unemployment has fallen, and finally poverty is starting to fall," Carlos Rodriguez, economics policy secretary at the Economy Ministry, said. "Poverty will continue falling."
